content.short: Alfa1 is a cryptocurrency asset management platform that combines traditional investment management technology with digital asset management services.
content.description: Alfa1, founded by Boris Feng and Wang Peng, is a cryptocurrency asset management platform that seeks to institutionalize crypto asset growth by advancing the underlying algorithms and technology powering the crypto ecosystem and blockchain. Users gain access to traditional financial investment management capabilities paired with digital asset management services to pursue consistent growth. Over the past three years, Alfa1 has grown to manage a book of over $300 million AUM across diverse crypto assets.
